about: Licence texts of components that ship in SGVue but are not installed in node_modules, read once on 2026-10-05 for scripts/third-party-notices.cjs, each with where it was read. "recordedFor": the versions of exceljs and web-ifc this was read for; the generator refuses to run against others. "webIfcSource": where the source of that web-ifc release is. "exceljsEmbedded": packages exceljs compiled into its browser build (dist/exceljs.min.js, per its source map) that npm does not install here; read from the npm registry tarball named, verified against its integrity. "read": "exact" is the version the bundle itself records, "latest" the registry's latest on that day (the source map records no versions). "webIfcNative": the C++ libraries web-ifc compiles into web-ifc.wasm, at the commits its src/cpp/CMakeLists.txt pins. "windowsOnly": what the Windows build alone adds beside the app. "adapted": source adapted into SGVue's own files.
